# Lab Request Management Test Suite

Feature: Lab Request Management
  As a lab user, I want to view and update open lab requests and submit reports offline
  My lab requests should be processed without requiring an internet connection

  Scenario: Viewing and updating open lab requests as a lab in-charge
    Given the lab in-charge has access to the lab request system
    When the lab in-charge views the open lab requests
    Then the lab in-charge should see the status of each request and be able to update it to "In Progress" or "Completed"

Scenario: Patient viewing Prescription and printing Invoice
  As a patient, I want to view my prescription and be able to print the invoice
    Given the patient has access to their prescription
    When the patient views their prescription
    Then the patient should see the details and be able to print the invoice

Scenario: Admin printing and emailing Prescription and Invoice
  As an admin, I want to print and email the prescription and invoice to patients
    Given the admin has access to the patient's prescription and invoice
    When the admin prints and emails the prescription and invoice
    Then the patient should receive the documents via email

Scenario: Archiving Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests
  As a system administrator, I want to archive profiles and requests that haven'thy raised any consultation for the last 3 years
    Given there are multiple patient profiles and consultation requests
    When the system performs the quarterly archive process
    Then profiles and requests older than 3 years should be archived
    And requests older than 3 years should trigger a review for potential archiving

# Test Cases in JSON Format
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Viewing and updating open lab requests as a lab in-charge",
    "req_ids": ["U31_10"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": "Lab in-charge has access to the lab request system",
    "inputs": {"requestId": "12345"},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to the lab request system",
      "Select the lab in-charge role",
      "View open lab requests",
      "Select request with ID 12345",
      "Verify the status can be updated to 'In Progress' or 'Completed'"
    ],
    "expected": "The status of request 12345 should be updated accordingly"
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Patient viewing Prescription and printing Invoice",
    "req_ids": ["U11"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": "Patient has access to their prescription",
    "inputs": {"prescriptionId": "67890"},
    "steps": [
      "Access the patient's prescription",
      "View the prescription details",
      "Print the invoice for prescription 67890"
    ],
    "expected": "The patient should successfully print the invoice"
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Admin printing and emailing Prescription and Invoice",
    "req_ids": ["U11"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": "Admin has access to the patient's prescription and invoice",
    "inputs": {"prescriptionId": "67890", "email": "patient@example.com"},
    "steps": [
      "Print the prescription for prescription 67890",
      "Email the prescription and invoice to patient@example.com"
    ],
    "expected": "The patient should receive the prescription and invoice via email"
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Archiving Patient Profiles older than 3 years without consultation requests",
    "req_ids": ["U12"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": "Multiple patient profiles and consultation requests exist",
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Perform the quarterly archive process",
      "Archive profiles older than 3 years",
      "Verify that these profiles are now in the archive"
    ],
    "expected": "Profiles older than 3 years should be archived"
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Archiving Consultation Requests older than 3 years",
    "req_ids": ["U12"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": "Multiple patient profiles and consultation requests exist",
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Perform the quarterly archive process",
      "Archive consultation requests older than 3 years",
      "Verify that these requests are now in the archive"
    ],
    "expected": "Consultation requests older than 3 years should be archived"
  }
]
